slides.title: Designed CV or *ATS* CV? Both.
slides.sub: Why you should keep two versions.

slides.title: What is an ATS?
slides.body: Many employers read CVs through screening software first. It prefers real text, clear headings and a simple layout.

slides.title: Send the plain one to online forms
slides.body: A single column with real text, headings and no tables is the safest for application systems.

slides.title: Send the designed one to people
slides.body: Emailing a recruiter, a manager or handing a CV over in person? A well-designed page makes a good first impression.

slides.title: Same words, two looks
slides.body: In AI CV Studio every design has a plain version. Switch any time without losing a word.
